note: Every target declared RAW (outside the warning and static-analysis gate) is registered here with an owner, a reason, an exit condition and a ticket. check_exemptions.py fails when a RAW target is missing from this file, when an entry points at a directory that no longer declares RAW (decoration), or when an entry is missing any field. Keep the list short; the point is that it is owned, not that it is empty.

exemptions.reason: third-party FreeRTOS port plus our own port code; the target has never been compiled under the warning gate, so its warnings are unmeasured rather than absent
exemptions.exit: flip to gated once the port compiles clean under -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror; tracked by the RTOS hardening work

exemptions.reason: Zephyr RTOS port; compiles with Zephyr native build system and headers under west build
exemptions.exit: gated in Zephyr CI workflow with CONFIG_ASSERT and warning flags
